import numpy as np, os
p='/workspace/task'; W=np.load(p+'/base.npy').astype(float); V=np.load(p+'/edited.npy').astype(float); D=V-W; cols=np.flatnonzero(np.any(D!=0,axis=0)); X=W[:,cols]; Y=D[:,cols]
u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(Y,full_matrices=False); r=u[:,0]; a=r@X; b=r@Y; c=-(a@b)/(a@a)
pred=-c*np.outer(r,a); err=Y-pred
print('scale',c,'rel residual',np.linalg.norm(err)/np.linalg.norm(Y),'abs residual',np.linalg.norm(err),'r norm',np.linalg.norm(r))
print('coeff residual',np.linalg.norm(b+c*a),'corr',np.corrcoef(a,b)[0,1]); print('per-column scales',-b/a)
print('cols',','.join(map(str,cols)))
print('r top',r[:10])
os.makedirs(p+'/out',exist_ok=True); np.save(p+'/out/r_hat.npy',r.astype(np.float32))
